g.text: Physics model: US Standard Atmosphere 1976 below 86 km and exponential segments (Vallado) to 1 000 km. Surrogates: numpy MLP 1-32-32-1 (tanh), 12 000
Adam steps on 601 altitudes, 0–600 km; hybrid = constant-scale-height fit to 500–600 km plus a learned correction. Timings: one CPU core, vectorised.
